summary: Master the art of managing and analyzing M&E data for development projects. Enroll in our course to gain essential skills for effective project evaluation.
lede: Managing, Analyzing and Interpreting M&E Data for Development Projects helps you turn field data into structured, defensible evidence for program decisions. Learn to design MEL plans and Logical Frameworks, establish robust data collection protocols, conduct Data Quality Assessments, and collect data offline with KoboToolbox. Build practical skills in quantitative and qualitative analysis, including statistical significance testing and coding key informant interviews. You will also learn to track indicators through automated IPTT dashboards (Power BI or similar), interpret findings against OECD-DAC criteria, and present clear evaluation narratives for adaptive management and donor reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals operating within NGOs, UN agencies, government bodies, and international development organizations who are responsible for measuring and reporting project outcomes.
modules: Digital Data Collection and Field Protocols
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of basic project management concepts and Microsoft Excel. No advanced statistical background or coding experience is required. A laptop is necessary for the digital data collection and visualization exercises.
